tabs.html:
DeepCool PN650D 650W 80 Plus Gold Non-Modular ATX 3.1 Power Supply

The DeepCool PN650D 650W 80 Plus Gold Non-Modular ATX 3.1 Power Supply is engineered to deliver exceptional reliability, efficiency, and performance for modern desktop systems. Built with the latest ATX 3.1 standard, it ensures compatibility with next-generation GPUs via its native 12V-2×6 (16-pin) PCIe connector, providing clean and stable power delivery even under demanding workloads.


With 80 Plus Gold certification, the PN650D maintains high efficiency across various loads, reducing heat generation and improving overall system stability. Its Full Bridge LLC + DC-to-DC topology ensures consistent voltage regulation, making it ideal for gaming PCs, creative workstations, and performance-oriented builds.

The PSU features a 120mm Hydro Bearing cooling fan, designed for ultra-quiet operation while maintaining excellent airflow. It includes essential industrial-grade protections such as OCP, OVP, UVP, SCP, OTP, and OPP, ensuring your components stay safe from electrical faults.


Built with durable components and backed by a 10-year manufacturer warranty, the DeepCool PN650D is a cost-effective and future-proof power solution for PC builders in Bangladesh looking for reliability and strong performance.
